steps: Obtain the vendor master with Udyam numbers
Verify category and activity on the Udyam portal for major suppliers
Tag micro and small suppliers in the books
items.text: Suppliers' Udyam registration and category (micro / small / medium; manufacturer, service or trader) obtained and tagged in books.

steps: Run bill-wise ageing of MSME creditors
Compare payment dates with the agreed period (max 45 days) or 15 days
List delayed payments
items.text: Payments made within the agreed period (max 45 days) or within 15 days where there is no written agreement.

steps: Obtain the RBI bank rate for the period
Compute interest at three times the bank rate with monthly rests
Agree with interest provided
items.text: Interest on delayed payments computed at three times the RBI bank rate, compounded with monthly rests.

steps: Prepare the s.22 disclosure (principal, interest due, paid, accrued)
Agree with ageing and interest working
Check the note in the accounts
items.text: Principal and interest due, interest paid and accrued disclosed in the financial statements.

items.how: Closing MSME creditors vs s.15 due dates.
steps: List MSME creditors unpaid at year end beyond the s.15 date
Compute the s.43B(h) disallowance
Report in clause 26
items.text: Unpaid amounts to micro and small enterprises beyond the s.15 period disallowed in the year of expense.

steps: Take the interest computed above
Confirm it is not claimed as a deduction
Report in clause 22
items.text: MSMED interest shown as not deductible.

items.ref: MCA order of 22 January 2019; MSME Form-1
steps: List MSME dues outstanding beyond 45 days at half-year ends
Check MSME Form-1 filing
Record defaults
items.text: Half-yearly MSME Form-1 filed for dues outstanding beyond 45 days (companies).
